title: Inline line grid shows $ on a EUR record while the form total shows €
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZrgaiMgTJCnswR6jQ

Found during PR #35998's browser reading (#35507 / #35804), out of that PR's scope. L1-a asked for a card (record 7058316549).

## What a user sees
On a showcase invoice in EUR (`INV-1010`), the edit form's inline line grid shows its currency cells and the line totals stack with `$`, while the form's "Total incl. Tax" shows `€`. Measured at head `d4100395` in headless Chromium. It was not investigated further.

## Expected
The line grid's currency cells and totals use the record's currency, the same symbol and format as the form's totals.

## Notes
Find where the grid's currency cells take their currency: the field default, the child record or the parent record. Check whether the read-only body table on the record page shows the same mismatch.
